title: Phase5 Rules UI v4 exact-shape pixel invisibility root cause
conclusion: The v4 geometry contract exists and all three token families reach the product draw stream, but the focus chevron, selected diamond outline, and both confirm frames are rasterized accent-on-accent over the opaque active rows. The final pixels therefore contain no visible chevron component, no closed diamond, and no closed confirm frame; only the kText check and bent enter-arrow remain visible.

control_flow_trace.finding: The armed action row is emitted, followed by armed_diamond_v4 in its trailing slot at lines 619-625. The confirm row is emitted, followed by focus_chevron_v4 and confirm_double_frame_enter_arrow_v4 at lines 652-667.
Enabled armed Action and Confirm panels select kAccent or kAccentCvd at lines 396-401. Constants are opaque standard [0.16,0.80,0.67,1] and CVD [0.98,0.70,0.18,1] at lines 15-16.
FocusChevron emits two joined segment calls and selects the same kAccent/kAccentCvd at lines 461-466. Four nondegenerate triangles exist, but their opaque RGB equals the confirm-row fill.

ArmedDiamond emits four outline segments using the same accent at lines 474 and 480-487, then two check segments using kText at lines 493-499. The outline disappears into the armed-row fill while the check remains.

ConfirmDoubleFrame emits outer and inner frame calls using the same accent at lines 508-514, then emits the bent enter-arrow using kText at lines 516-530. Both frames disappear into the confirm-row fill while the arrow remains.

Shape triangles use the global safeRect from rules_decision_product_draw.cpp lines 155-159, not a row-slot clip. The GPU builder appends all primitives first and then all UiTriangle values at lines 341-380, so the shapes execute after panels and glyph primitives. No later panel overwrites them.

The test accepts token presence, triangle counts 4/12/24, and triangle bounding boxes at least 18x18. It does not rasterize the composited row or test foreground contrast, outline closure, or connected components.

shape_contract derives nominal size/stroke from profile math and writes selected_closed_diamond=true, confirm frame count=2, and passed=true without consuming a raster snapshot. Its validator therefore verifies a declared contract rather than visible output.

primary_root_cause.mechanism: The final composited outline/stroke color is exactly equal to the opaque active-row background in both standard and color_vision_safe palettes.
primary_root_cause.observed_effect: All four frozen images have zero visible selected outline closures, zero confirm frame closures, and zero independent focus chevron components.

secondary_layout_defect.mechanism: The focus slot starts at row leading x+8*scale while glyphLine starts the confirm text at the row's x. No leading content inset or dedicated non-overlap reservation exists.
secondary_layout_defect.observed_effect: Each focus crop contains copy glyph fragments at its top edge. A future visible chevron could collide with copy unless the row reserves the slot.

verification_escape.mechanism: The accepted machine and unit checks prove logical emission and nominal geometry only.
verification_escape.observed_effect: An accent-on-accent implementation passes 540 machine cases and token/bbox assertions while remaining visually failed in every repaired profile.

ruled_out.ruled_out_by: Exact v4 items exist in armed-confirm and current tests observe all three token IDs.
Token triangle counts are 4 focus, 12 selected, and 24 confirm; renderer rejects degenerate triangles before submission.
kAccent and kAccentCvd alpha are both 1.0.
Draw-list containment passes and triangles carry only the global safeRect, which contains all measured slots.
GPU build order emits primitives before the triangle stream; the shape triangles remain last relative to panels/glyph primitives.

ruled_out.candidate: single resolution or single palette aliasing
ruled_out.ruled_out_by: The same topology appears at 1280x720, 1920x1080, 2560x1440, density 1/2, standard and color_vision_safe.

required_correction_direction: Use an independent shape-outline foreground whose machine-measured contrast against the actual active-row background is at least 4.0:1 in standard and color_vision_safe after compositing; do not change inherited thresholds to obtain a pass.
Reserve a dedicated, non-overlapping leading focus slot and inset confirm copy accordingly while preserving the existing localized actor/action text and row/hit semantics.

Add deterministic CPU raster snapshots at all four repair profiles. Inspect final pixels, not only token metadata: chevron joined-component/span, diamond closure/check enclosure, two confirm frame closures/arrow separation, alpha/clip/overwrite survival, physical sizes, and CVD equivalence.
Keep token, triangle-count, and bbox assertions as supporting diagnostics only. They can never independently satisfy the v5 visual gate.
non_authorizations: No authority, rules, action inventory/order, actor/action copy, submission, placement, inherited threshold, product exposure, Beta, Golden, M2, real-input, or screen-reader change.
No production edit, build, GPU authorization, GPU execution, capture, or technical-art pass is performed or claimed by this report.
